description: Next-gen firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, email security, web security, vulnerability management, SIEM & SOAR, and certificate/PKI — threat detection and SecOps. ESCU detections are distributed across subcategories 10.1–10.8.

subcategories.name: CIM Data Model Standard Monitoring Patterns

useCases.title: Failed Authentication Ratio Trending
useCases.value: Rising failure ratio vs. successes indicates credential attacks, misconfigured apps, or account lockout waves — normalized via CIM across vendors.

useCases.title: Authentication Type Distribution
useCases.value: Tracks Kerberos vs. NTLM vs. SAML mix to spot downgrade attacks and legacy protocol use.

useCases.title: Impossible Travel Detection (CIM)
useCases.value: Two successful auths from distant `src` locations within a window that precludes travel — vendor-agnostic when geo is mapped to CIM.

useCases.title: Service Account Interactive Login (CIM)
useCases.value: Service accounts should not have interactive / remote-interactive logons; indicates credential theft or misconfiguration.

useCases.title: Authentication Source Diversity
useCases.value: Many distinct `src` addresses for one `user` in a short window suggests shared credentials or stuffing.

useCases.title: MFA Failure Rate Trending (CIM)
useCases.value: MFA fatigue attacks and token issues both raise failure rates; CIM unifies IdP vendors.

useCases.title: Off-Hours Authentication (CIM)
useCases.value: Privileged or bulk success auths outside business hours warrant review.

useCases.title: Password Spray Detection via CIM
useCases.value: Many users with single failure from same `src` — classic spray pattern visible after CIM normalization.

useCases.title: Top Talkers Analysis (CIM)
useCases.value: Baselines bytes and sessions by `src`/`dest` for capacity and exfiltration hunting.

useCases.title: Protocol Anomaly Detection (CIM)
useCases.value: Unexpected `app`/`transport` on a segment (e.g., SMB from workstation VLAN to internet).

useCases.title: Connection Duration Outliers (CIM)
useCases.value: Very long flows may indicate tunneling; very short bursts may indicate scanning — CIM `duration` enables cross-vendor analytics.

useCases.title: Internal-to-External Traffic Ratio (CIM)
useCases.value: Sudden shift in egress ratio can signal C2 or misrouted backups.

useCases.title: DNS Query Volume (CIM)
useCases.value: DNS tunneling and malware generate high `query` counts per `src` — normalized in `DNS` CIM model.

useCases.title: Network Session Anomaly (CIM)
useCases.value: Session count per host vs. baseline — lateral movement and port scans increase discrete sessions.

useCases.title: Malware Detection Rate Trending
useCases.value: Tracks EDR/AV detection volume normalized as `Malware` CIM for executive and SOC trending.

useCases.title: Quarantine Success Rate
useCases.value: Ratio of `action=blocked` or vendor quarantine to total malware events — failed containment drives risk.

useCases.title: Recurring Infection (Same Host)
useCases.value: Repeat malware on same `dest` indicates failed remediation or persistent foothold.

useCases.title: Malware Family Distribution
useCases.value: Shifts toward ransomware or infostealer families prioritize IR playbooks.

useCases.title: Endpoint Malware Coverage
useCases.value: Hosts with no malware events in 30d may be offline, mis-deployed agents, or blind spots — compare to CMDB.

useCases.title: IDS Alert Severity Trending
useCases.value: Tracks IDS/IPS `severity` mix over time for tuning and attack campaigns.

useCases.title: Signature Hit Analysis
useCases.value: Top `signature` hits drive tuning priority and threat hunting focus.

useCases.title: False Positive Ratio (IDS CIM)
useCases.value: When analysts tag disposition, or vendor provides `action`/`priority`, measure noise ratio per `signature`.

useCases.title: Attack Vector Distribution
useCases.value: `category` or `ids_type` field shows web vs. email vs. network vector concentration.

useCases.title: IDS Signature Update Compliance
useCases.value: Sensors reporting stale `vendor_severity` or outdated rule versions — map vendor feed metadata to custom index if not in CIM.

useCases.title: Vulnerability Age Tracking
useCases.value: Time open since `first_found` drives SLA and board reporting.

useCases.title: Remediation Velocity
useCases.value: Median time from `first_found` to `status=closed` by team — CIM-normalized across scanners.

useCases.title: CVSS Distribution
useCases.value: Histogram of `severity` / CVSS for backlog risk profile.

useCases.title: Asset Risk Scoring (CIM)
useCases.value: Aggregate open vulns per `dest` weighted by CVSS for top-risk hosts.

useCases.title: Vulnerability Scan Gap Detection
useCases.value: Assets in CMDB without recent vuln assessment event in CIM — scanning blind spot.

useCases.title: Email Volume Anomaly
useCases.value: Spike in `Email` model message count may indicate spam flood, phish campaign, or misconfigured relay.

useCases.title: Attachment Type Analysis
useCases.value: Tracks `file_name` extensions / MIME for macro and archive risk.

useCases.title: Internal-External Mail Ratio
useCases.value: Sudden flip to mostly external recipients may indicate data exfil via email or open relay abuse.

useCases.title: Delivery Failure Trending
useCases.value: Rises in `action` bounce/drop indicate reputation issues, DNS problems, or attacks.

useCases.title: HTTP Method Distribution
useCases.value: Surge in `PUT`/`DELETE` or rare methods may indicate API abuse.

useCases.title: HTTP Response Code Trending
useCases.value: 5xx and 4xx rates from CIM `status` for SLO dashboards.

useCases.title: User Agent Analysis
useCases.value: Rare or known-bad `http_user_agent` strings — scraping and legacy clients.

useCases.title: Bandwidth by Category
useCases.value: When `app`/`url` category exists in CIM or via lookup — top GB by category.

useCases.title: Web Application Error Rate
useCases.value: Application-level errors in `status` 500 series or custom `error` field in CIM extensions.

useCases.title: Change Velocity Tracking
useCases.value: Count of `All_Changes` per day — spikes suggest emergency change storms or automation gone wrong.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Change Detection
useCases.value: Changes without ticket ID or with `user` not in CAB roster — map `object_attrs` to CIM.

useCases.title: Change-to-Incident Correlation
useCases.value: Incidents within 4h of `result` success on same `dest` — causal analysis for CAB feedback.

useCases.title: Configuration Drift Analysis
useCases.value: Repeated `change_type=update` on same `object_id` without matching change record — drift vs. process.

useCases.title: Change Window Violations
useCases.value: Production changes outside approved windows — `_time` vs. lookup `allowed_window`.

useCases.title: Process Execution Anomaly
useCases.value: Rare `process_name` on endpoint fleet — living-off-the-land and malware binaries.

useCases.title: Service State Changes
useCases.value: Stopping security services (AV, EDR) or critical agents — `Endpoint.Services` state changes.

useCases.title: Filesystem Integrity
useCases.value: FIM events for critical paths (`/etc`, `C:\Windows\System32`) — map vendor FIM to Endpoint `Processes`/`Files` tags or parallel sourcetypes.

useCases.title: Registry Modification Tracking
useCases.value: Persistence via `Registry` keys — `action=set` on Run keys.

useCases.title: Installed Software Changes
useCases.value: New or rare `process_path` / binaries on servers — inventory or package logs mapped to Endpoint.

useCases.title: Endpoint Resource Utilization (CIM)
useCases.value: Sustained high CPU on many endpoints may indicate cryptomining or ransomware — use `Performance` DM when TAs map `cpu_load_percent` (field name varies by TA).
